inputs.text: Hand-painted 2D inventory icon of a rounded green jade pendant with a thin soft gold line inset along its outer bevel. Three visibly separate bamboo stalks of different lengths overlap diagonally in shallow jade relief. Each stalk has bamboo joints and a few narrow pointed leaves. Two small curled cloud engravings flank the bamboo in the open green areas. Polished emerald jade, clear dark silhouette, pierced suspension ear, burgundy cord and one silk tassel, flat magenta background.
